latency_repeatability.how: inference latency of the same full-sensor definition in the superseded and the final run (from MLflow); only one repeat per model, so this is an indication, not a variance estimate

operator_observations.status: observed by the operator with system tools during the session; NOT recorded in any run's metadata
operator_observations.power: battery power: about 88% before launch, 27% at a later check after completion
operator_observations.load: other applications were running; load average about 3 to 4 before launch
